notes.title: Version 1.0.2 Update
notes.content:
[h3]Bug Fixes and Optimizations[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the final boss could not be unlocked.
[*] Fixed an error in the spell card unlock count in the codex.
[*] Fixed a display error with the All-In ability and attack power bonus.
[*] Optimized animation loading for relic selection and shop events to prevent issues on lagging computers.
[*] Added new filtering options in the deck editor based on enchantment points and rarity.
[*] Fixed a bug where relics like Pineapple malfunctioned when replacing relics.
[*] Adjusted the effect of Joint Operation + Spell Card:
[*] Changed from "Draw 2 spell cards from your own deck" to "Draw 1 public spell card and 1 spell card from your deck."
[*] Adjusted the prices of certain Law Cards.
[*] Added a new restriction to Law Cards in the shop:
[*] If the Poker Deck has fewer than 10 cards, services related to removing poker cards will be disabled.
[*] Fixed a bug where no cards were drawn after failing the Wu Yi event.
[/list]

notes.title: V1.0.1 Update Notes
notes.content:
[h3]Bug Fixes and Optimizations[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where Izell’s attack increase was incorrect when losing health.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the game to freeze when selecting the Inspiration Lightbulb relic.
[*] Optimized spell card generation: if there are already at least two copies of a spell card in the deck, it will no longer appear in the shop.
[*] Fixed an issue where clicking too fast during settlement caused experience rewards to be abnormal.
[*] Fixed a bug where the star count for Legendary Journey achievements was calculated incorrectly.
[*] Fixed an issue where purchasing a spell card, upgrading it, and then removing it caused the game save to fail.
[*] Added a new option in settings for illustration unlock prompts. When enabled, players can see whether a relic or shop item is unlocked in the illustration collection.
[*] Fixed a bug where the "Initial Deck Composition" achievement could not be triggered.
[*] Adjusted battlefield missions:
[*] Removed the "Reduce enemy HP to zero" mission.
[*] Added new missions for dealing damage, healing, and playing specific card patterns.
[*] Fixed a bug where the "Thunderous Might" achievement could not be triggered.
[*] Fixed a display bug where editing initial spell cards showed upgraded versions instead.
[*] The "Remove Spell Card" service in the shop will be disabled when there are fewer than five spell cards.
[/list]

notes.title: [Playtest Recruitment] Rebuilding the Game After 180 Days of Demo Launch?
notes.content:
Based on the classic gameplay of "Dou Dizhu," Happy Cards is a roguelike card strategy game that has received significant player feedback since its participation in the October New Releases Festival. These suggestions have made us realize fundamental flaws in the game's core mechanics and logic! However, since the game is developed by just two people, we hope to gather more ideas to improve the gameplay further.

After thorough discussions among our team, we've decided to rebuild the game from scratch. To ensure the revamped game meets player expectations, we are now recruiting players for testing. If you'd like to join, simply join our Happy Cards Discord: https://discord.gg/NVTbmpXscx.
And send a private message to the group admin to receive your test access. We are offering 500 testing slots, distributed on a first-come, first-served basis!


Key Updates and Changes:
Core Gameplay Overhaul
We've introduced an attack boost mechanism for card combinations, enhancing the impact of powerful hands. For example, "King Bomb" adds +70 attack, while "Three with One" adds +20 attack, and so on.

New Rule Card Mechanic
Players can purchase rule cards in the shop to remove cards, add cards, or change card suits. Imagine having only Jokers in your hand—exciting, right?

Simplified Systems
The redundant rune system has been removed. We've redesigned all spell cards and the relic system to ensure every spell card has a distinct purpose rather than just adding volume. Relics now directly influence deck-building, such as converting all card suits to Spades and Hearts or adding five Aces to your hand.

Distinct Character Traits
Each character now has unique playstyles. For example, Angie uses "5 Wildcards," while Lulu's hand contains only Spades and Hearts.

Although we've rebuilt the game, we still need extensive feedback and suggestions from players to refine it further. Therefore, we earnestly invite you to participate in our playtest!

Join our Happy Cards Discord group: https://discord.gg/NVTbmpXscx
We also encourage you to share your thoughts—whether suggestions or criticisms, we will humbly accept them. After testing, please fill out our survey; your feedback is incredibly important to our small indie development team. Thank you for your support!

notes.title: War of the Three Kindoms+Doudizhu card game Happy Card join in SteamNextFest now
notes.content:
The roguelike card game "Happy Card" has undergone multiple version tests and optimizations based on player feedback. This new version for SteamNextFest introduces exciting content, including the addition of Rule Cards, allowing players to modify their decks—such as changing two cards to Spades. We've also optimized level lengths and added more Relics and Star Blessing effects, among other updates. We invite both new and returning players to search for and download the demo for free on Steam, or add it to their wishlist. The official release is expected in Q4 2024!
